svg.text: Nikon D3000 wired release (option B) · DRAFT v0.4 · 2026-11-07 · camera float charger added · camera interface bench-verified (HALF, FULL, PWR) · spec v0.23 §6.2/§6.3, §11.3, §12.1
A · POWER, CAMERA SUPPLY, SENSE, STATUS LED
CAMERA SUPPLY — float charger, EN-EL9a stays in
Camera + / − in parallel with the EN-EL9a (it answers the S check). ≤ 8.0 V, ≤ 1 A
(§11.3, PW-06…PW-11). Never raw +VBAT on J2 while the battery is in. One fuse (F1).
On-board WS2812 RGB LED of U1 (data on IO48 on a v1.0 board, IO38 on v1.1)
No external parts. Patterns per §9.3, same driver approach as the RLC.
The LED sits inside the enclosure: use a small light pipe or window and keep
it out of the lens view (no flare, not in frame). Check the board revision first.
On the dev board: 3.3 V LDO, EN reset
Flash with the pack switched OFF and
USB connected; never both at once.
C · CAMERA INTERFACE (3 × PC817, low-side switch lines)
Collector → camera line (pull-up in the camera), emitter → BLU. Release = HALF (U4) first, then FULL (U3) (FR-N04); both end at REST.
* The camera-side S wire is blue, the same colour as BLU. Tag both ends of each wire;
BLU is the one with continuity to BLK (black), S is not (see spec §6.2).
Idle levels and short-circuit currents measured: YEL 4.71 V / 0.12 mA, WHT 3.31 V / 0.064 mA, GRN 4.72 V / 0.01 mA.
YEL stays at 0 V during a full press (HALF is held closed), so a release needs both U4 (HALF) and U3 (FULL).
Pull-up values are estimates from the measured currents; the camera's low threshold is above 0.6 V (diode test).
1. All GPIO are 3.3 V logic. Outputs use IO4/5/6 and IO7 (buzzer, as built 2026-11-06). IO0, IO3, IO45, IO46 and IO35–37 (octal PSRAM) are left free; the on-board LED uses IO48 (v1.0) or IO38 (v1.1).
2. Opto LED current ≈ (3.3 − 1.2) V / 1 kΩ ≈ 2 mA. The 10 kΩ pull-downs keep every opto off while the ESP32 is in reset (FR-N02, shutter in REST).
3. BLU is the opto return and is deliberately not tied to GND at the node; it meets BLK inside the camera. A broken BLU wire means no release (fail-safe).
4. U5 (green line) is optional: shorting GRN to BLU switches the camera off, an open opto lets the knob decide (ON). Feature is off by default.
5. The buck feeds 5.0 V to the dev board's 5V0 pin and its on-board LDO makes 3.3 V. Power options are mutually exclusive: no USB while the pack is on.
6. Capacitors: C1 100 µF, C2 47 µF, C3 100 nF. Resistors 1 % metal film. Gotron references in gotron_bestellijst.md. Buck min. input ≈ 6.0 V (node cutoff 6.6 V).

7. Camera cable: 7 conductors. J2: red + (float charger), brown S (n.c.), black −; S wire is blue like BLU: tag it. J3: orange FULL, red HALF, brown ON/OFF, black = BLU. Brown/black repeat: different nets.
8. BZ1 active buzzer: + to IO7 (as built; was drawn on IO15), − to GND, direct drive (2 mA at 3.3 V measured). One fixed pitch: patterns by rhythm only.
9. Not yet verified: camera float charger U6/D1/R10 (T-46…T-48, O-12; lab supply at 8.21 V OK 2026-11-07), camera current (O-11), 5 V dev-board current, buck, final GPIO map.
